rule: Pre-registered rule (written before any odds request or model output): the EARLIEST 2025-26 regular-season, D-I vs D-I, non-neutral game with an EXACT tip on or after the validated replay window start, both teams in a high-major conference (the provider's player-prop coverage proxy), team + player box scores for both teams, a substitution feed and every box-score player canonically identified. Ordered by tip, then canonical id. The second row is the ONLY allowed fallback (used only if the first event's payload has no player-prop market).
selection_basis: DATA AVAILABILITY / INTEGRATION COVERAGE ONLY (no odds, no model output inspected)
